newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki stocks seen starting up over one pct.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki stocks seen starting up over one pct.

text.p: Shares were seen opening more than a percent higher on Thursday after the Dow topped 8,000 points overnight and Nokia rose on Wall Street, brokers said.
"We won't stop at one percent at the open, everybody will be marking their prices up and we'll see this rise one to 1.5 percent within the first 10 minutes," one broker said.
Another predicted stocks would rise easily by one percent at the open and could gain by three percent for the day.
"There's no bad news in sight ... this may be the kind of day we've never seen before," she said.
In New York, Nokia's ended at about 451.00 markka, about 10.00 markka above its Helsinki close.
"Nokia will be up a percent at the open, and could easily gain two to three percent today," one broker said.
Forestries were seen stronger after the S&P index tracking U.S. paper-makers rose 2.27 percent overnight, brokers said.
Even after two days of massive gains, Raisio was seen with further upside, and one broker said it could soon be at 600.00 after closing up 87.00 markka at 565.00 on Wednesday.
